lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Monday night in Telluride Town Council, where the 2027 budget and its accompanying property tax levy go to a vote — and right alongside it, a second reading on suspending the Open Space Fund's 5% cut of Real Estate Transfer Tax revenue for the year, a move that puts fiscal pressure and land conservation directly in tension. Norwood's Planning and Zoning Commission is also doing foundational work Monday, taking up both a Land Use Code update and a Master Plan update that will shape what gets built in that community for years. Over in Ouray County Tuesday, the BOCC considers resolutions to repeal existing austerity measures and adopt a formal AI governance policy, two signals about where that county is headed.
